mentions.name: AI Intent Driven Development
mentions.description: This repository defines the AI Intent Driven Development methodology, in which an Intent is a self-contained document describing a user request. Each Intent has three main sections: WHY (the motivation), WHAT (the requirements, often written in Gherkin), and HOW (a detailed step-by-step implementation plan defined with tasks), ensuring clarity and alignment before any code is written.
